text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia on Monday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Andris Shkele is later today expected to give his assesment on the situation of Transport Minister Vilis Krishtopans, found to be in formal violation of the anti-corruption law but who has refused to resign.
- The Baltic Challenge '97 military excercises continues at Estonia's Paldiski base, where Latvia is represented by 160 officers and soldiers.
